title: Elegant modern vase (Print in vase mode)
author: lajtert3Dstudio
description:
This vase seamlessly integrates into any modern interior. Its elegant twisted pattern and clean lines provide a unique appearance that can enhance any room.

Download the STL file and print your own copy to enjoy this distinctive decoration in your home.

Printed in vase mode.

Dimensions (original):

height:200mm, diameter:160mm

Dark brown vase reduced to 60%. h:120mm,d:96mm)

Filament:Polymaker PolyTerra PLA Earth Brown, PolyTerra PLA Army Beige

Print instructions:

Filament: PLA

Print: 0.2mm

Nozzle: 0.4mm

Perimeters: VASE MODE

Brim: Not need

Support: Not need
